stages.label: Intake
stages.behavior: Understand the report. Ask for the missing field if needed. Call capture_browser_context to collect sanitized evidence.

stages.label: Review
stages.behavior: Build the draft. Consult the knowledge base for expected behavior and severity. Ask one focused clarification when a required field is missing. Call github_duplicate_search. Render the preview with render_issue_preview. Ask explicitly for confirmation.

stages.label: Submit
stages.behavior: After explicit spoken confirmation, call github_issue_create. Render the result with render_submission_result. Never create without confirmation; on decline keep the preview and stop.

outcome.description: Final outcome of the report session.

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number when created or a duplicate was found.

duplicate_found.description: Whether a duplicate issue was detected during review.

dynamic_variables.build_id: Browser build ID from the app.
dynamic_variables.report_session_id: Per-session report identifier from the app.
